ResourceHeader.Description: TRACERS 2 Electric Field Instrument (EFI) high frequency (EHF) time-series and spectra data sampled by the EFI x-antenna, which is along the x-axis in the TRACERS Spacecraft Coordinates System (TSCS). The data are derived from 16384-sample snapshots, collected at a sampling rate of 1 sample per 50 nano-s. In the Region of Interest (ROI), the snapshots are collected once every 16 s; in the BackOrbit (BOR) the snapshots are collected every 2048 s (BAC). Each spectrum consists of 4097 linear frequency bins from 0 to 10 MHz.

InformationURL.Name: TRACERS MISSION
InformationURL.Description: Tandem Reconnection and Cusp Electrodynamics Reconnaissance Satellites (TRACERS), consisting of two identical satellites in low polar orbit about the Earth, to investigate how solar wind transfers energy and mass into Earth's near-space environment.

InformationURL.Name: Electric Fields Instrument (EFI)
InformationURL.Description: Electric field measurements with a sampling rate for EDC of 128 samples/s (ROI), 8 samples/s (BOR), EAC 2048 samples/s (ROI), electric field high frequency (EHF) 20e6 samples/s (ROI). For EAC and EHF the sampling rate is the same as the ROI, but the cadence is 16 s and 2048 s respectively.
